name: Creampots Touring Caravan & Camping Park
accommodation: 61 grass and hardstanding pitches for tents, trailer tents, caravans, motorhomes and campervans; seasonal pitches
parking: Space for two cars per pitch
beachAccess: About 1.5 miles from Broad Haven beach (Visit Pembrokeshire)
confirmedFeatures: Free Wi-Fi, toilet and shower block, 10-amp hook-ups, laundry, indoor dishwashing, children's ball game area
overview: Creampots is a sheltered touring and camping park at Broadway, inland of Broad Haven, with 61 level pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. Broad Haven beach is about a mile and a half away, and the park opens from March to early October.
surfTripFit: A quiet, inexpensive campsite a few minutes' drive from Broad Haven, with hook-ups and laundry for longer stays.
